30 numbered steps you do yourself. For each step: first what to click and type, the SQL to paste and what you should see; under it the real DMCR Web screen, captured while these exact steps were run. Product A builds a sequence, a table, a type, a function and a materialized view; Products B and C change them, and on Oct 20 both add the same column. At the end, 8 SQL files Product C's team ran on test by hand are imported and shipped (#24–#30). Only test (zapper_st, schema zp_st) and prod (zapper_prod, schema zp); the SQL never names a schema.

Before you start

What you need

  • DMCR Web on http://127.0.0.1:7798, workspace C:\Users\salilvnair\workspace\dmcr_repo
  • PostgreSQL on localhost:5432 with zapper_st and zapper_prod (step 1 empties them)
  • Settings › DMCR Config: test schema zp_st, prod schema zp
  • DBeaver for the optional look at the data

No schema in the SQL

Every change says zp_lookup_data, never a schema. DMCR runs each environment in the schema set in DMCR Config, like picking it in DBeaver, so the same files go from test to prod.

Every saved change

  • Check the card says Self-check passed (or Fixed before you saw it)
  • Set Project and Requested by
  • Save to workspace, then Commit

Found and fixed during this run

Running these steps for real turned up these DMCR problems. Each was fixed and the step run again; the screens show the fixed behaviour.

Found by the import steps (#24–#30)

  • A change replacing a function first made with a plain CREATE FUNCTION (012 over 009) got a revert that restored it word for word, CREATE FUNCTION included, which fails with already exists; the self-check failed every time. A restored definition is always CREATE OR REPLACE now (3aa6cf7)
  • The AI added SET search_path FROM CURRENT to an imported function, so prod got a different lookup_label_for than test and Schema Diff showed drift after the deploy. A function or view in an imported change is now the file's text, word for word (b507013)
  • A data change's verify on test was reported as failed when its backup table was missing (on test the SQL ran by hand); it now says no backup on test, however verify.sql words it (b507013)
  • Running the trial again kept the last run's marks until the new result came, and rows the trial never reached showed a red not_run; now they clear, and unreached rows say not reached (01f29e8)

Changed in the runner since this run

  • A later change that only adds or updates rows in a table no longer counts as superseding an earlier change that created or altered that table: a failing check of the table's structure is a real failure. #21 still ends the same way (9 OK, 3 superseded); 002 is now superseded by 007 and 008 only. That screen was captured again on the same state (9a2324e)
  • Files that differ only in line endings (CRLF / LF checkouts) are no longer counted as edited; verify all exits 1 on a real failure; a failed repeatable fails the deploy (a14bde5, 9a2324e)

Added since the first run (07f9b92)

  • verify all --env test after the import failed on 020 (and listed 016, 019 among the rest) because their backup tables exist only where DMCR ran the deploy. Changes recorded as applied without DMCR running them now verify with a stand-in backup: no backup here, not a failure, and the run exits 0
  • Never send to prod: Releases › Changes › the lock on a change (its release then does not count it on prod, deploys to prod skip it, and Schema Diff shows what it creates as an expected difference); in Import from test, never send to prod on a file's row (not tried on prod, saved for test only) (07f9b92, f28dbcd)

Fixed in DMCR

  • Nothing stopped a second change from adding the same column: the card now says Already added by another change; Conflicts flags the same column added by two parallel projects (92bac28)
  • A revert that restored a $$ function word for word wrote $ and failed (0782e24)
  • An index on a materialized view created in the same change was called a lock risk (0782e24)
  • Set up DMCR did not create the environment's schema; it does now, no psql step (d4bd9bb)
  • Releases showed an empty page and a banner per environment before you knew whether DMCR was set up; every tab but Settings now opens on a first-run wizard (DBA name, changes folder, databases, AI provider, each database set up, with progress) until DMCR can work (3270035)
  • The self-check error on a card named zp_st.zp_lookup_data; it shows names without the schema now, like the SQL (ccb62a2).
  • DMCR Config rebuilt its fields on every render (the DBA name flickered); pages wait for their data behind a loader (61740b5)
